messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

{"chapter":11,"verses":[{"chapter":11,"text":"It came to pass the second night that I saw a dream, and behold, an eagle which had twelve feathered wings and three heads came up from the sea.","verse":1},{"chapter":11,"text":"I saw, and behold, she spread her wings over all the earth, and all the winds of heaven blew on her, and the clouds were gathered together against her.","verse":2},{"chapter":11,"text":"I saw, and out of her wings there grew other wings near them; and they became little, tiny wings.","verse":3},{"chapter":11,"text":"But her heads were at rest. The head in the middle was larger than the other heads, yet rested it with them.","verse":4},{"chapter":11,"text":"Moreover I saw, and behold, the eagle flew with her wings to reign over the earth and over those who dwell therein.","verse":5}],"book_code":"2ES"}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return exactly source verse numbers 1,2,3,4,5 in this chapter.
